result.title: Multimodal Fusion with Pre-trained Models for Psychotherapy Outcome Prediction from Emotional Dynamics
result.comment: Preprint. 18 pages, 7 figures; 6-page supplementary material as ancillary file. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
result.summary: In-session emotional dynamics are associated with psychotherapy outcomes but difficult to measure at scale. Pretrained multimodal models provide automated access to facial, vocal, and textual signals, yet clinical datasets remain small. Our research question is how pretrained multimodal representations can best support psychotherapy outcome prediction under data scarcity. Three studies use 106 sessions from 88 patients and nine session-level outcome scales (HSCL-11, EPO-1, POMS). Study 1 asks whether deep learning outperforms classical machine learning: a two-stage deep pipeline, first predicting window-level valence/arousal and then session outcomes, transferred poorly (best single configuration, $r=.078$). Study 2 asks which representation and preprocessing choices work best: statistical pooling of frozen pretrained embeddings with regularized classical models achieved average $r=.406$ across nine scales under per-scale configuration selection, up to $r=.490$ for symptom distress, with complementary modalities and no significant benefit from manual affect annotations or therapist features. Study 3 asks whether deep learning remains inferior under these choices: classical models outperformed an optimized single-stage deep model at the single-configuration level ($r=.281$ vs. $.222$) and on all nine scales under matched per-scale selection ($.406$ vs. $.252$). The results suggest that under clinical data scarcity, pretrained representations with fixed statistical pooling and regularized classical models are more reliable than learned aggregation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用88名患者共106次会谈的面部、声音与文本预训练表示预测心理治疗结局，通过三项研究比较大、小规模配置下的深度学习管线与「冻结嵌入统计池化＋正则化经典模型」的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其小数据下「冻结预训练表示＋固定统计池化」优于学习式聚合的经验对比，可能为 LVR 中视觉/多模态证据的池化与聚合监督选择提供核查线索，但论文不涉及推理状态生成或证据筛选，联系较间接。
